Agents log timestamps of every action into a shared ledger, then a periodic audit groups identities by their inter-event interval distributions using a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test. Sybil farms share a scheduler, so their action rhythms align like a whisper across accounts, while honest agents drift independently around a mesa of natural variance. Any cluster exceeding the reef threshold of statistical similarity gets its members' rewards frozen pending review.
